g.text: Title: Haptic bracelet - UART ring wiring

g.desc: Title: Haptic bracelet - UART ring wiring

g.text: One wrist / ring pod schematic draft

g.desc: One wrist / ring pod schematic draft

g.text: EIGHT PODS / SIX-WIRE CHAIN / LOGICAL UART RING

g.desc: EIGHT PODS / SIX-WIRE CHAIN / LOGICAL UART RING

g.text: Each pod: M2003FC1AE + DRV2625 + LRA. Pod 0 shares its housing with the ESP32/power electronics.

g.desc: Each pod: M2003FC1AE + DRV2625 + LRA. Pod 0 shares its housing with the ESP32/power electronics.

g.text: ESP TX -> D0 -> pod 0 -> D1 -> ... -> pod 7 -> D8 -> R53 -> RETURN -> ESP RX

g.desc: ESP TX -> D0 -> pod 0 -> D1 -> ... -> pod 7 -> D8 -> R53 -> RETURN -> ESP RX

g.text: RETURN passes through each intermediate board without an MCU connection. R53 fitted at end pod only.

g.desc: RETURN passes through each intermediate board without an MCU connection. R53 fitted at end pod only.

g.text: Wire J101->J104, J105->J108, ... J125->J128 pin-for-pin. No cable between end pod and main pod across clasp.

g.desc: Wire J101->J104, J105->J108, ... J125->J128 pin-for-pin. No cable between end pod and main pod across clasp.

g.text: Power, GND, reset and VBAT follow the chain; each pod has a protected battery and local positive fuse.

g.desc: Power, GND, reset and VBAT follow the chain; each pod has a protected battery and local positive fuse.

g.text: IN/OUT: 1 switched 3V3, 2 GND, 3 forward DATA, 4 MCU reset, 5 VBAT, 6 RETURN to ESP RX.

g.desc: IN/OUT: 1 switched 3V3, 2 GND, 3 forward DATA, 4 MCU reset, 5 VBAT, 6 RETURN to ESP RX.
